meta.triageRationale: bugfix/small: one function in one shared module plus its test; reuses the existing failWith settle path.

body.focus: Fix ISSUE-c9d0c355: in runReviewStream (src/shared/review-stream.ts), a transport that throws while being opened settles the request as a ReviewStreamError with failure 'unreachable' (message naming the method and the cause), with the wait timer cleared and the abort listener removed. Neither transport changes. Add a unit test in src/shared/__tests__/review-stream.test.ts that a synchronously throwing transport settles 'unreachable' and clears its timer; src/daemon/steps/__tests__/in-daemon-client.test.ts then exits on its own.
body.summary: runReviewStream now settles a transport that throws while opening as 'unreachable', releasing the wait timer and the abort listener; in-daemon-client.test.ts exits on its own again and the full sweep finishes.
